_comment: Your next attack this turn gets +3{p}. You may destroy a Bloodrot Pox token you control; if you do, gain 1{h}. Go again. Prior JSON used MODIFY_ATTACK (current attack, not next) and MAY_DESTROY_SILVERS_TO_EQUIP (a Mechanologist equip effect) instead of destroy-Bloodrot-Pox -> gain 1 life. Now MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK + a MAY(gated on controlling a Bloodrot Pox) -> DESTROY_TOKEN + GAIN health.

effects.prompt: Destroy a Bloodrot Pox token you control to gain 1 life?
